purpose: AI/intelligence substrate (ADR-0562 charter): OAuth subscription-pool gateway (ADR-0384 Path B) multiplexes the AI-agent fleet over pooled provider credentials; pure seat-pool state machine in intelligence-kernel; axum reverse-proxy + SSE lease lifecycle in intelligence-rest; transient authz-cedar + openbao + eventsink adapters; facade composition roots (intelligence-app, intelligence-worker). Also hosts SDK/provider adapters, agentic kernels, and the absorbed intelligence/detection/ sub-tree (owns its own absorbed sub-service manifest). Fifty workspace members under intelligence/{adapters,core,facade}/ are accounted below; intelligence/testing/third-party-test-deps is support-only and excluded from crate accounting.

OAuth subscription-pool Path B for AI-agent fleet multiplexing

per-tenant token-bucket rate limiting remains Unimplemented::PerTenantRateLimit (501) — deferred, not claimed shipped

hyperscaler_inv_coverage.circuit_breaker: Per-key failure-count blacklist threshold + jittered cooldown in intelligence-kernel acts as a per-upstream-key circuit breaker (open on N consecutive failures, half-open on cooldown expiry via lazy restore). Per-provider fallback chain is implemented via the group routing layer: multiple groups can serve the same channel class with independent pools, and the failover loop rotates across keys within a group. No cross-process shared breaker state is claimed.
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.tenant_rate_limit: The gateway authenticates ingress proxy-keys and implements per-key failure isolation. Per-tenant token-bucket rate limiting is tracked as a deferred item at registry/placeholder-debt/adr-follow-ups.yaml#adr-0373-cloud-intelligence-per-tenant-rate-limit and surfaced as Unimplemented::PerTenantRateLimit (501) when invoked.
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.golden_signals: OTel-aligned metrics via structured tracing events expose request outcomes, per-key success/failure, retries, upstream latency, and active-key gauge (oya_cloud_intelligence_*) with Prometheus text exposition at /metrics. Scrape wiring to Alloy/VictoriaMetrics is deployment-time.
hyperscaler_inv_coverage.error_budget_burn: OpenSLO error-rate and availability SLO files authored at intelligence/observability/slos/. Burn-rate alert wiring to VictoriaMetrics is deployment-time; no live SLO burn is claimed for the local-foundation phase.

pod_runtime_tier_justification: The agent-dispatch gateway brokers pooled provider credentials and is intended Tier-2 isolation (first-party application microservice, runc). No runtime pod deployment is claimed for the local-foundation phase; tier is retained as the intended isolation class.

capacity_model.notes: The gateway is a stateless reverse proxy (pooled keys are ephemeral in-memory cache resolved through owned secret-provider handles). Storage is 0 GB (no gateway-owned persistent state). Outbound HTTP connections are the upstream provider connections per active tenant. CPU/RAM are conservative design estimates for the local-foundation phase; measured baselines replace these once the gateway is live.
